title: Luscious Juicy Filipino Pork Leche Flan
description: A creamy and savory Filipino dish featuring pork, mustard powder, and a soffritto base, perfect for a date night, and can be made dairy-free friendly.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, cook the pork shoulder over medium heat until browned.
Add the chopped onions and cook until they are translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
In a large bowl, whisk together the coconut cream, eggs, mustard powder, salt, and black pepper.
Add the cooked pork mixture to the bowl and stir until well combined.
Pour the mixture into a hot pot vessel or a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake for 35 minutes or until the edges are set and the center is slightly jiggly.
Remove from the oven and let cool to room temperature.
Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving.
